annotations.title: Get live stats for one Solana validator by vote account or identity pubkey.

description: Get live stats for one Solana validator by vote account or identity pubkey. Pass vote (vote account pubkey) or identity (node identity pubkey). Returns stake in SOL with share and rank, commission, delinquency, how many slots its last vote is behind the cluster, vote credits for each of the last 5 epochs per SOL staked, as a percentage of the cluster median (100 = median; approximate, as it uses today's stake), and current-epoch leader slots, blocks produced and skip rate next to the cluster's. Unknown keys return 404. Costs $0.001 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; the first 3 paid-tool calls per day are free for MCP clients while a shared daily allowance lasts. Without x402 support, later calls return the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: Solana mainnet-beta (public chain state via JSON-RPC), Public on-chain data.
